title: Pump moved from throttling to a variable speed drive, with site constants
description: ILLUSTRATIVE: a centrifugal pump that was throttled by a discharge control valve now runs on a variable speed drive. kW before is a measured average; kW after is a range because the after-measurement month had two production rates. All numbers, including the site constants, are made up for this example.

changes.label: Pump P-101 on a variable speed drive
